message.content: {"note_claim": "The extended ISS stay for Sunita Williams and Butch Wilmore was due to helium leaks and problems with the spacecraft's maneuvering thrusters on the Boeing Starliner.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "NASA and Boeing identified helium leaks and experienced issues with the spacecraft reaction control thrusters on June 6 as Starliner approached the space station.", "reason": "The NASA page directly states that helium leaks and reaction control thruster issues were the reason Starliner would return uncrewed, with the astronauts remaining on the ISS."}

parsed.note_claim: The extended ISS stay for Sunita Williams and Butch Wilmore was due to helium leaks and problems with the spacecraft's maneuvering thrusters on the Boeing Starliner.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: NASA and Boeing identified helium leaks and experienced issues with the spacecraft reaction control thrusters on June 6 as Starliner approached the space station.
parsed.reason: The NASA page directly states that helium leaks and reaction control thruster issues were the reason Starliner would return uncrewed, with the astronauts remaining on the ISS.
